meta.scope: Present-day religion and language distribution, Sudan and South Sudan.
meta.rules: Shares only where a cited page states them (all APPROXIMATE). Religion: US State Dept IRF cites dropped entirely (IM ruling 2026-10-26); Pew Research Center 2020 (PEW_RELCOMP_2020, proposed, unregistered) is the primary source. Those entries sit in 'religions_pending_registration' (not read by web/mapsite.py write_pl) with approx_share_pct null until registered; 'religions' is empty. Pew has no separate indigenous/traditional category; its 'other religions' column is kept under that name. Languages: Glottolog country lists only; no speaker shares or scripts. place_ids only from db/cities.json, no coordinates.
gaps: No UNHCR/OCHA/UNFPA/UN Statistics or Ethnologue page with religion/language figures was opened this pass; not cited.

Religion: no published religion entries until PEW_RELCOMP_2020 is registered; no sub-national religion distribution from an opened, registrable source (State Dept regional detail dropped with the IRF cites).
